rule: translate: at least one accepted answer, lang is es or en, no distractor is a word of the primary answer, and the word bank holds 4 to 12 tiles. Accepted answers never repeat once normalized.

cases.name: no-answers
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[0] › lessons[0] › exercises[1] › translate: needs at least one accepted answer

cases.name: unsupported-language
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[0] › lessons[0] › exercises[1] › translate › lang: Input should be 'es' or 'en'

cases.name: distractor-in-the-answer
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[0] › lessons[0] › exercises[1] › translate: distractors must not be words of the primary answer: marta

cases.name: too-few-tiles
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[0] › lessons[0] › exercises[1] › translate: needs 4 to 12 word-bank tiles (answer words and distractors), has 3

cases.name: too-many-tiles
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[0] › lessons[0] › exercises[1] › translate: needs 4 to 12 word-bank tiles (answer words and distractors), has 13

cases.name: answers-equal-once-normalized
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[0] › lessons[0] › exercises[1] › translate: accepted answers (after normalization) repeat: hello marta

cases.name: contraction-twin
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[1] › lessons[0] › exercises[1] › translate: accepted answers (after normalization) repeat: hello i am luis
